name: afro_house
what: Afro house production from Africa's Calling (docs/demo_study): the filter is the build (a low-pass opening over eight bars into each drop), swells and throws instead of risers, no gaps or stutters, and a medium pump on the music bus only (its loudest section swings 2.6 dB): the percussion keeps rolling through every change.
section_gains_how: Not applied blind: after the first render read measure_section_levels' contrast and run apply_section_gains with by_role {'scale': x}, aiming from the measured slope (tools/remix_song.py does this).
